en.title: Bible Answer in Claude, Grok and Codex
en.lead: Find Bible reading guides, exact Scripture quotations, and links to their sources directly in Claude, Grok, or Codex.
en.about: Copy this address to connect Bible Answer. It reads published guides in six languages and does not require a Bible Answer account.
en.claude: Open Customize → Connectors → Add custom connector. Enter Bible Answer as the name and paste the address above. Choose No sign in if prompted. Enable Bible Answer in the chat’s Connectors menu.
en.grok: Open Connectors → New Connector → Custom. Enter Bible Answer as the name, paste the address above, then select Add Connector.
en.codex: Run this command in your terminal. Start a new Codex session after adding the connector.
en.prompt: Use Bible Answer to find a reading guide for Psalm 23. Tell me which Bible translation it quotes and link to the original guide.
en.read: Read the guides on the website
en.privacy: The connector receives a topic and a language. Your chat service handles the rest of the conversation under its own privacy policy.

ru.title: Bible Answer в Claude, Grok и Codex
ru.lead: Находите разборы библейских отрывков, точные цитаты и ссылки на источники прямо в Claude, Grok или Codex.
ru.about: Скопируйте этот адрес для подключения. Коннектор открывает опубликованные разборы на шести языках. Аккаунт Bible Answer не нужен.
ru.claude: Откройте Customize → Connectors → Add custom connector. Укажите название Bible Answer и вставьте адрес выше. Если появится выбор способа входа, выберите No sign in. Включите Bible Answer в меню Connectors в чате.
ru.grok: Откройте Connectors → New Connector → Custom. Укажите название Bible Answer, вставьте адрес выше и нажмите Add Connector.
ru.codex: Выполните эту команду в терминале, затем откройте новую сессию Codex.
ru.prompt: Найди через Bible Answer разбор Псалма 22 на русском. Назови перевод Библии и дай ссылку на разбор.
ru.privacy: Коннектор получает только тему и язык. Остальную переписку обрабатывает сервис чата по своей политике конфиденциальности.

es.title: Bible Answer en Claude, Grok y Codex
es.lead: Encuentra guías de lectura bíblica, citas textuales y enlaces a sus fuentes directamente en Claude, Grok o Codex.
es.about: Copia esta dirección para conectar Bible Answer. El conector consulta guías publicadas en seis idiomas y no requiere una cuenta de Bible Answer.
es.claude: Abre Customize → Connectors → Add custom connector. Escribe Bible Answer como nombre y pega la dirección. Si te pregunta cómo iniciar sesión, elige No sign in. Activa Bible Answer en el menú Connectors del chat.
es.grok: Abre Connectors → New Connector → Custom. Escribe Bible Answer como nombre, pega la dirección y selecciona Add Connector.
es.codex: Ejecuta este comando en tu terminal. Después, inicia una nueva sesión de Codex.
es.prompt: Usa Bible Answer para encontrar una guía del Salmo 23 en español. Indica qué traducción bíblica cita y enlaza a la guía original.
es.read: Leer las guías en el sitio web
es.privacy: El conector recibe un tema y un idioma. Tu servicio de chat gestiona el resto de la conversación según su propia política de privacidad.

pt.title: Bible Answer no Claude, Grok e Codex
pt.lead: Encontre guias de leitura da Bíblia, citações exatas e links para as fontes diretamente no Claude, no Grok ou no Codex.
pt.about: Copie este endereço para conectar o Bible Answer. O conector consulta guias publicados em seis idiomas e não exige uma conta do Bible Answer.
pt.claude: Abra Customize → Connectors → Add custom connector. Digite Bible Answer como nome e cole o endereço. Se for solicitado a escolher uma forma de login, selecione No sign in. Ative o Bible Answer no menu Connectors da conversa.
pt.grok: Abra Connectors → New Connector → Custom. Digite Bible Answer como nome, cole o endereço e selecione Add Connector.
pt.codex: Execute este comando no terminal. Depois, inicie uma nova sessão do Codex.
pt.prompt: Use o Bible Answer para encontrar um guia do Salmo 23 em português do Brasil. Diga qual tradução bíblica ele cita e inclua o link para o guia original.
pt.privacy: O conector recebe um tema e um idioma. O serviço de chat processa o restante da conversa de acordo com a própria política de privacidade.

fr.title: Bible Answer dans Claude, Grok et Codex
fr.lead: Trouvez des guides de lecture biblique, des citations mot pour mot et des liens vers leurs sources dans Claude, Grok ou Codex.
fr.about: Copiez cette adresse pour connecter Bible Answer. Le connecteur consulte des guides publiés en six langues. Aucun compte Bible Answer n’est nécessaire.
fr.claude: Ouvrez Customize → Connectors → Add custom connector. Saisissez Bible Answer comme nom et collez l’adresse. Si Claude demande un mode de connexion, choisissez No sign in. Activez Bible Answer dans le menu Connectors de la conversation.
fr.grok: Ouvrez Connectors → New Connector → Custom. Saisissez Bible Answer comme nom, collez l’adresse, puis sélectionnez Add Connector.
fr.codex: Exécutez cette commande dans le terminal, puis ouvrez une nouvelle session Codex.
fr.prompt: Utilise Bible Answer pour trouver un guide sur le Psaume 23 en français. Indique la traduction biblique citée et donne le lien vers le guide original.

fr.privacy: Le connecteur reçoit un sujet et une langue. Votre service de conversation traite le reste des échanges selon sa propre politique de confidentialité.

fil.title: Bible Answer sa Claude, Grok at Codex
fil.lead: Maghanap ng mga gabay sa pagbasa ng Bibliya, eksaktong sipi, at link sa pinagmulan sa Claude, Grok, o Codex.
fil.about: Kopyahin ang address na ito para ikonekta ang Bible Answer. Nagbabasa ito ng mga nailathalang gabay sa anim na wika. Hindi kailangan ng Bible Answer account.
fil.claude: Buksan ang Customize → Connectors → Add custom connector. Ilagay ang Bible Answer bilang pangalan at i-paste ang address. Kung hihingi ng paraan ng pag-sign in, piliin ang No sign in. I-on ang Bible Answer sa menu ng Connectors sa chat.
fil.grok: Buksan ang Connectors → New Connector → Custom. Ilagay ang Bible Answer bilang pangalan, i-paste ang address, at piliin ang Add Connector.
fil.codex: Patakbuhin ang command na ito sa terminal, at pagkatapos ay magsimula ng bagong session sa Codex.
fil.prompt: Gamitin ang Bible Answer para maghanap ng gabay sa Awit 23 sa Filipino. Sabihin kung anong salin ng Bibliya ang sinipi at ibigay ang link sa orihinal na gabay.
fil.read: Basahin ang mga gabay sa website
fil.privacy: Paksa at wika ang natatanggap ng connector. Pinoproseso ng serbisyo ng chat ang ibang bahagi ng usapan ayon sa sarili nitong patakaran sa privacy.
